title: Quantoz launches PLNQ as a Polish-złoty electronic-money token
description: Quantoz announced PLNQ as launched and initially issued on Ethereum, with Zodia Markets named as the initial institutional distribution partner.
notes: The event records the official launch and verified initial Ethereum deployment; later announced networks remain unverified.
